text: As a buyer on Vendora Marketplace, you are protected by our community guidelines and buyer protection program.

## Buyer Rights
- You have the right to receive products exactly as they are described on the listing.
- You have the right to secure and encrypted payments.
- You have the right to leave honest reviews (1 to 5 stars) after a verified purchase.

## Buyer Responsibilities
- Do not engage in abusive behavior or use inappropriate language in reviews or chatbot interactions.
- Ensure your shipping address is accurate before placing an order.
- Promptly report any suspicious vendor activity to Vendora Admin.

## Dispute Resolution
- In the event of a dispute, Vendora acts as a neutral mediator. Both the buyer and seller will be required to submit photographic evidence.
# Vendora Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

## 1. How do I pay for my order?
We support multiple payment methods:
- Cash on Delivery (COD) (Default and most popular)
- Easypaisa
- JazzCash
- SadaPay

## 2. Is my payment secure?
Yes. For prepaid orders, payments are held securely by Vendora and only released to the vendor once the buyer confirms successful delivery.

## 3. How do I become a seller on Vendora?
You can sign up as a Vendor from the homepage. You will need to provide your business name, contact details, and upload a copy of your National ID (CNIC). Admin approval is required before your shop goes live.

## 4. What if I receive a damaged product?
Contact support@vendora.pk immediately with photos of the damaged item and the packaging. We will assist you in getting a replacement or a full refund under our Return Policy.

## 5. Can I cancel my order?
Orders can only be cancelled while they are in the "pending" status. Once an order is "confirmed" or "shipped", cancellation is no longer possible.
Welcome to the Vendora Marketplace Help Center.

## How to use the AI Assistant
Vendora provides a smart AI chatbot in the bottom right corner of the screen. You can ask it to:
- Find specific products (e.g., "Find me a blue pottery vase under 5000").
- Answer questions about shipping or returns.
- Check the inventory of a specific item.

## Account Management
- You can update your profile information in the "Profile" section.
- If you forget your password, you can reset it via the Firebase Auth login screen using the "Forgot Password" link.

## Contacting Support
If the AI chatbot cannot resolve your issue, you can reach out to our human support team at support@vendora.pk. Our typical response time is 24 hours.
Vendora Marketplace strives to ensure that you get a full refund if your experience is unsatisfactory.

## Eligibility for Refunds
- You can request a refund if the item was never delivered.
- You can request a refund if the item received does not match the description or photos.
- Refunds must be requested within 14 days of the original delivery date.

## Refund Process
- To initiate a refund, navigate to "My Orders" and click "Dispute/Refund".
- The vendor has 48 hours to respond. If they fail to respond, Vendora automatically approves the refund.
- Refunds are processed back to the original payment method (JazzCash, Easypaisa, SadaPay, or Bank Transfer). Cash on Delivery (COD) refunds will be issued to your digital wallet.

## Timelines
- Approved refunds take 3-5 business days to reflect in your account.
# Vendora Return & Refund Policy

## General Return Policy
- Products can be returned within 7 days of delivery.
- Items must be unused, in their original packaging, with all tags attached.
- To initiate a return, buyers must contact support@vendora.pk with their order ID and a picture of the received item.

## Refunds
- Refunds are processed once the vendor receives the returned item and verifies its condition.
- For Cash on Delivery (COD) orders, refunds are credited to the user's Vendora Wallet or can be transferred to Easypaisa/JazzCash upon request.
- For prepaid orders (Easypaisa, JazzCash, SadaPay), the refund will be reversed to the original payment method within 5-7 business days.

## Exceptions
- Perishable goods (e.g., fresh food, custom baked items) cannot be returned.
- Personalized or custom-made items (e.g., custom engraved jewelry) are non-refundable unless they arrived damaged or defective.
Vendora Marketplace relies on reliable and honest merchants. By registering as a vendor, you agree to these terms.

## Vendor Registration and Verification
- All vendors must submit a valid CNIC for identity verification.
- Stores will remain in "pending" status until an Admin manually approves the account.

## Product Listing Guidelines
- Products must be described accurately. Misleading titles or stock images of different products are strictly prohibited.
- Vendors must maintain accurate stock counts. Selling items that are out of stock will negatively impact your vendor rating.
- Selling illegal, counterfeit, or prohibited items (such as weapons, narcotics, or unauthorized pharmaceutical drugs) will result in immediate permanent account suspension.

## Fees and Payouts
- Vendora takes a 5% commission on all successful sales.
- Payouts are dispersed every Friday to the vendor's linked bank account or mobile wallet.
# Vendora Shipping Policy

## Delivery Time
- Standard delivery across major cities in Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Rawalpindi, Islamabad) takes 3 to 5 business days.
- For remote areas and smaller cities, delivery may take up to 7 business days.

## Shipping Fees
- Vendora charges a flat shipping rate of Rs. 250 per package from a single vendor.
- If an order contains items from multiple vendors, each vendor's package will incur a separate Rs. 250 shipping fee, as items are dispatched directly from the respective merchants.

## Order Tracking
- Once an order is marked as "shipped" by the vendor, buyers can view tracking updates in the "My Orders" section of their profile.
